packing: Whole-body bitmap frames only. Uniform page/cell scaling into the same 192-square canvas, pivot (96,156); no silhouette fitting, runtime body-part assembly, bob, sway or rotation. Opposite facings reflect the whole frame with a six-pose phase shift. Two-pixel clear gutters. Drawing coverage does not imply art production approval.
